title: ChatGPT Integrates with Adobe Suite: 70+ Creative Tools Can Be Accessed with a Single Sentence, No Need to Switch Software for Photo Editing and Video Editing

content_html:
Adobe's collaboration with OpenAI has expanded significantly today. Users can now directly call more than 70 Adobe tools such as Photoshop, Premiere, Acrobat, Lightroom, Illustrator, and InDesign in ChatGPT to complete tasks such as photo editing, marketing video production, and PDF generation.

At the end of last year, Adobe had already integrated Photoshop, Acrobat, and Adobe Express into ChatGPT using OpenAI's Apps SDK. Starting August 6th, the scope of the collaboration expanded to almost the entire creative software suite. After adding the Adobe plugin on the plugin page in the ChatGPT settings menu, users can simply type "@Adobe" and a specific task in the prompt input box to call the corresponding tool.

Adobe stated that the plugin works best when used in conjunction with OpenAI's Codex programming application and the recently released Work suite. Users can use basic features without logging into a Creative Cloud account, and after logging in, they can save work progress across different sessions and directly access cloud files. A Creative Cloud account can also be used to call the generative AI models provided by Adobe Firefly.

Forrest Key, Vice President of Adobe Firefly and AI Agents at Adobe, said: "We hope that no matter where people work, they can use Adobe's professional creative and productivity tools." However, he also emphasized that the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT is not a replacement for flagship applications, "when precise operations and full control over the creative process are needed, the flagship applications can still provide deeper functionality."

This collaboration signifies that ChatGPT is evolving from a conversational tool into a "super workspace," allowing users to complete creative production processes without switching between multiple software applications. For Adobe, this is a strategic move to embed its own tool ecosystem into AI-native workflows; for OpenAI, it is another initiative to expand the practical scenarios of ChatGPT and enhance user engagement.

content_html_zh:
Adobe 与 OpenAI 的合作如今已显着扩大。 用户现在可以在ChatGPT中直接调用Photoshop、Premiere、Acrobat、Lightroom、Illustrator、InDesign等70多种Adobe工具，完成照片编辑、营销视频制作、PDF生成等任务。

去年年底，Adobe 已使用 OpenAI 的 Apps SDK 将 Photoshop、Acrobat 和 Adob​​e Express 集成到 ChatGPT 中。 从8月6日开始，合作范围几乎扩展到整个创意软件套件。 在ChatGPT设置菜单的插件页面添加Adobe插件后，用户只需在提示输入框中输入“@Adobe”和具体任务即可调用相应的工具。

Adobe 表示，该插件与 OpenAI 的 Codex 编程应用程序和最近发布的 Work 套件结合使用时效果最佳。 用户无需登录 Creative Cloud 帐户即可使用基本功能，登录后可以跨不同会话保存工作进度并直接访问云文件。 Creative Cloud 帐户还可用于调用 Adob​​e Firefly 提供的生成式 AI 模型。

Adobe Firefly 和 AI Agents 副总裁 Forrest Key 表示：“我们希望无论人们在哪里工作，都可以使用 Adob​​e 专业的创意和生产力工具。” 不过，他也强调，ChatGPT中的Adobe插件并不是旗舰应用程序的替代品，“当需要精确操作和对创作过程的完全控制时，旗舰应用程序仍然可以提供更深层次的功能。”

此次合作标志着ChatGPT正在从一个对话工具演变为一个“超级工作空间”，让用户无需在多个软件应用之间切换即可完成创意制作流程。 对于 Adob​​e 来说，这是将自己的工具生态系统嵌入到 AI 原生工作流程中的战略举措；对于OpenAI来说，这是拓展ChatGPT实用场景、增强用户参与度的又一举措。
